product_overview: Fungga Wari Lab is an immersive storytelling platform for Meitei and broader Asian folk narratives, pairing a public reader experience with a creator dashboard for managing stories, series, assets, tasks, billing, and settings. The system uses Clerk for authentication, Supabase for backend data and RLS-protected access, and Cloudinary for media delivery.
core_goals: Provide a cinematic public reading experience for published stories
Enable creators to manage stories, series, library materials, media assets, tasks, billing, and account settings from a dashboard
Use Clerk authentication with Supabase-backed, RLS-secured data access
Support cloud-based media management through Cloudinary-integrated asset workflows
Present a scalable monorepo architecture with shared UI components and consistent design tokens

features.name: Dashboard Overview
features.description: Shows creators high-level metrics and quick links into the rest of the dashboard.
user_flows: GET /overview with an authenticated session -> Receive 200 with summary metrics and dashboard shortcuts -> Render overview cards and navigation links
GET /overview without an authenticated session -> Receive an authorization error or redirect response -> Prompt the user to sign in before dashboard data loads

features.name: Story Management
features.description: Lets creators view, create, edit, and manage stories from the dashboard.
user_flows: GET /stories with a valid authenticated session -> Receive 200 with story list and management data -> Display story rows, statuses, and edit actions
GET /stories with an expired or missing auth token -> Receive 401 or equivalent access failure -> Show sign-in or access-denied state instead of story data

features.name: Series Management
features.description: Organizes stories into collections or series for sequential publishing and navigation.
user_flows: GET /series with an authenticated session -> Receive 200 with series collection data -> Render series list and allow creators to manage episode groupings
GET /series without valid auth -> Receive 401 or redirect to login -> Block access to series management until authentication is complete

features.name: Library
features.description: Provides access to reference materials and reusable library assets for creators.
user_flows: GET /library with a valid session -> Receive 200 with library materials -> Render reference items and asset listings in the dashboard
GET /library with missing authentication -> Receive authorization failure -> Prevent viewing library materials and request sign-in

features.name: Media Assets
features.description: Supports Cloudinary-integrated media upload, browsing, and asset management for stories.
user_flows: GET /assets with an authenticated session -> Receive 200 with media asset records -> Show uploaded images and asset management controls
GET /assets without proper authentication -> Receive 401 or denied access -> Hide asset management UI and require login before continuing

features.name: Tasks
features.description: Tracks content creation tasks and to-dos so creators can manage work in progress.
user_flows: GET /tasks with an authenticated session -> Receive 200 with task list data -> Display task items, statuses, and completion controls
GET /tasks with invalid credentials -> Receive authorization error -> Block task viewing and prompt for re-authentication

features.name: Billing
features.description: Displays subscription status, paywall information, and billing management actions.
user_flows: GET /billing with an authenticated session -> Receive 200 with subscription and paywall state -> Show billing status, plan details, and upgrade or management actions
GET /billing without valid auth -> Receive 401 or redirect response -> Prevent billing access until the user signs in

features.name: Settings
features.description: Allows creators to configure user and organizational preferences in the dashboard.
user_flows: GET /settings with an authenticated session -> Receive 200 with settings data -> Render account and organization configuration forms
GET /settings with missing or expired auth -> Receive authorization failure -> Stop settings loading and require the user to authenticate
